parsed.rationale: Although the two types share structural shape (both are `type-alias-object` with `shared_field_count: 1` and no fields listed), they carry distinct names — `TextHeightPreferenceKey` in `app:WatchXYC` (`WXYC/WatchXYC/PlayerPage.swift:140`) and `ScrollOffsetPreferenceKey` in `app:iOS` (`WXYC/iOS/Views/Playlist/Playcut Detail/PlaycutRowView.swift:74`) — indicating they encode different domain concepts (text height measurement vs. scroll offset tracking) whose structural coincidence is incidental. SwiftUI `PreferenceKey` conformances are typically small, single-purpose value types that are intentionally local to the view file that uses them; extracting them to a shared target would couple two unrelated app targets over a trivial implementation. No restraint markers are present, but the coincidental-shape reason dominates here.
